transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I've just been feeling really deeply depressed and sad lately. It's been going on for about eight months now, and I finally decided I needed to seek some help.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?

I'm really not sure, to be honest. I can't think of any specific event or trigger that started all of this. It just sort of crept up on me, and these feelings have been persisting like this for about eight months now.
Before these past eight months, had you been feeling down or depressed most days for at least two years, or is this more of a newer episode?
I haven't really experienced this level of depression before these past eight months. It definitely feels like a newer episode for me.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Yes, completely. The hobbies and activities I used to love don't bring me any happiness or satisfaction anymore. I just feel totally indifferent to them now, like they don't matter at all.
How have your sleep, appetite, and energy been during this time?
Honestly, I haven't noticed any significant changes in my sleep or my appetite. My energy levels seem pretty normal too, so there haven't been any major issues there.
Have you been feeling especially worthless, hopeless, or guilty during this time?
I haven't really felt particularly worthless, hopeless, or guilty. It's more that I just feel completely empty and emotionally numb inside. It feels like my emotions have just been shut off.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to die, hurt yourself, or that life isn’t worth living?
No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I've never wanted to hurt myself or felt like I wanted to die.
How much have these symptoms been affecting your daily life, like your work, relationships, or ability to keep up with responsibilities?

These feelings have severely impacted my life over the last eight months. Because of my lack of motivation, I find it incredibly hard to start or finish work tasks and feel completely indifferent to my achievements. I've also been withdrawing socially, avoiding contact with my friends and family, which has really strained my relationships.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days or more when you felt unusually energized or euphoric, needed much less sleep, or were more impulsive than usual?

No, I've never experienced a period like that where I felt unusually energized or euphoric. In fact, it has been the exact opposite for me, as I mostly just feel down, empty, and completely lacking any real drive or energy.
Have you started any new medications, been using alcohol or drugs more, or had any medical problems that began around the time these symptoms started?
No, I haven't started any new medications since this all began. I also don't use alcohol or drugs, and I haven't had any new medical or physical health problems either.
